claim: ASE's CFO said in April 2026 that its full-process leading-edge advanced packaging (LEAP) services were projected to generate about US$300 million of revenue in 2026, reaffirmed as on track in the Q2 2026 call, with substantial growth expected in 2027.
evidence: "full-process LEAP services, a business that is projected to generate US$300 million in revenue this year, Tung said." (Taipei Times, 30 Apr 2026); "we said that we're going to have about TWD 300 million worth of revenue coming from that space, and things are on track" (Q2 2026 call, Motley Fool)

metric.name: ASE full-process LEAP revenue target
metric.population: ASE LEAP revenue from full-process (turnkey CoWoS-like) lines, as opposed to on-substrate outsourcing
metric.methodology: Company guidance as reported by the press and third-party transcripts

notes: Fact-check correction of CLM-1609: the currency is US$ per the Taipei Times. Transcripts render it 'TWD ... million dollar', which contradicts itself, and NT$300m would be implausible next to US$3.5bn LEAP revenue.

claim: Besi's FY2025 results release (19 Feb 2026) said hybrid-bonding adoption expanded to 18 customers and cumulative orders grew to 150+ systems in 2025, and that six integrated hybrid-bonding production lines with 30 Besi hybrid bonders were installed at a leading logic customer in collaboration with Applied Materials.
evidence: "hybrid bonding adoption expanded to 18 customers, cumulative orders grew to 150+ systems"; "six integrated hybrid bonding production lines were installed at a leading logic customer incorporating 30 Besi hybrid bonders in collaboration with Applied Materials" (Besi FY2025 release, CEO comment)

metric.name: Besi cumulative hybrid-bonding system orders
metric.period: cumulative to end-2025 (start year not stated)
metric.population: Hybrid bonding systems ordered from Besi (Besi definition)

notes: Fact-check correction of CLM-1619: removes 'since 2021', which the release does not say. The 18-customer figure conflicts with Besi's later 15 for end-2025 (CLM-1622).
